description_blocks.text:
Generic 2.5-inch SATA drive reference from the FreeCAD Parts Library, not a manufacturer product. Model by MrFreez, licensed CC-BY-3.0; unchanged source geometry. Verify fit against the chosen drive before designing a printed tray or enclosure.

Community geometry by MrFreez, not a manufacturer model or a certification of any particular drive. The source model body is 100.45 x 69.85 x 7 mm (length x width x height); these are model dimensions, not universal form-factor limits. Mounting holes, SATA connector position, cable bend space and operating clearances must be verified against the chosen physical drive and its manufacturer drawing. Model geometry is retained unchanged; CC-BY-3.0 attribution and the source asset license accompany it. This model is specifically 7 mm high; it does not represent 9.5 mm or 15 mm drives.
